preamble: AKS preserves knowledge with integrity, traceability, reproducibility, and long-term maintainability. Evidence remains independent of interpretation. AKS is domain-independent; repositories implement the framework.
fundamental_principles: Canonical objects are derived from evidence.

repository_layers.name: Analysis
repository_layers.description: Reproducible reasoning derived from canonical objects.

repository_layers.name: Publications
repository_layers.description: Human-readable outputs derived from lower layers.

repository_evolution.rule: Major architectural changes require an ADR.

drift.structural: Changes affecting architecture, schemas, identifiers, workflows, or organization.
drift.semantic: Changes affecting definitions, terminology, or meaning.
drift.policy: Monitor, document accepted drift, correct undesired drift.

publication_policy: Publications are derived artifacts and shall remain reproducible from repository evidence.
methodology_rule: Operational Manual and Methodology implement but may not contradict the Constitution.
framework_scope: AKS is domain-independent; repositories extend but do not redefine it.
closing_principle: Preserve knowledge so it remains understandable, auditable, reproducible, and trustworthy across time.
